help_desc: Show GeoIP status: DB load state, action mode, blocked countries / ASNs.
msg_db_missing: etc_geoip.lua: %s database not found at '%s' - GeoIP checks for it are disabled. Run geoipupdate (see docs/BLOCKLIST.md).
msg_db_stale: etc_geoip.lua: %s database is older than 30 days (built %s) - run geoipupdate to refresh.
msg_denied: You are not allowed to use this command.
msg_report: [ GEOIP ]--> The user %s with IP %s (%s) is not permitted (%s). Action: %s.
msg_update_fail: [ GEOIP ]--> database auto-update failed: %s (keeping the last-good database).
msg_update_missing_key: etc_geoip.lua: auto-update is on but no MaxMind account_id / license_key is set - see docs/BLOCKLIST.md.
msg_update_start: [ GEOIP ]--> auto-update: checking %s for updates at MaxMind...
